individual-data-points.explanation: The lower bar graph shows HMGB1 signal intensity as mean+SD bars (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes without overlaid individual data points, despite N=4, n>100 measurements underlying it.
The lower bar graph shows % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells as mean+SD bars without individual data points overlaid, despite N=4, n>400 underlying measurements.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a line plot of rotarod performance over time; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points as overlay would make them unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots of rotarod performance across days; line plots are exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Panel G is a histological micrograph image without an accompanying plot of averaged data.
Both bar graphs (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) show mean+SD bars without individual data points overlaid, despite N=3, n=9 underlying measurements.
